lines.en: I bounce forward, one hop at a time.

lines.zh: 落地的时候我摊成一滩。
lines.en: On landing I flatten into a puddle.
I swell up and hop again.
My body is dark red.

lines.zh: 我跳过一块石头，晃了晃。
lines.en: I hop a stone and wobble.
I slide a short way along the ground.
I bounce toward you.

lines.zh: 我跳一下，里面的东西响。
lines.en: Each hop and something rattles inside me.
I roll over the grass.
I stick to the soil and pull free.
I advance in stops and starts.
Wet marks stay behind me.

lines.zh: 我从坡上跳下去，落地很响。
lines.en: I hop down the slope and land loudly.
I circle once and come back at you.
Each hop is faster than the last.
I land in water and it splashes.
I slump on the ground and move slowly.
I tremble faintly all the time.
Something turns inside me.
I swell and subside.
The sun warms me through.
I'm waiting for something to come near.
The red on me has darkened.
No lungs, and nothing to gasp for.

lines.zh: 我把一小块留在石头上。
lines.en: I leave a bit of myself on the stone.

lines.zh: 风把我表面吹起一层波纹。
lines.en: The wind ripples my surface.
I ooze to the foot of the wall, out of the sun.
I spread myself very thin.
Your boot tip is right beside me.
I bounce once at you.

lines.zh: 我身上沾了一点你的味道。
lines.en: There's some of your smell on me.
I bounce up and settle back.
One step from you and I hop.
It's sticky and hot inside me.
I swell a notch and lean your way.
Better to run than hit me.

lines.zh: 我落地的声音你听见了吗。
lines.en: Did you hear me land?
I hop again.

lines.zh: 我摊开一大片，又聚回来。
lines.en: I spread wide and gather back.

lines.zh: 这一下打散了我的一角。
lines.en: That scatters a corner of me.
I quiver a long time before settling.
A few red drops land on the ground.
I have lost a layer and I am still red.
I slowly swell up again.
I squeeze into a crack, a thin line.
I tremble as I shift.
I haven't come apart yet.
I head your way again.
I can wrap around that.
I creep over an inch at a time.
I wrap it up completely.
It dissolves inside me.
Not enough for me to grow.
I'll keep it in there.
I've swollen a little larger.

lines.zh: 你口袋里还有能化的吗。
lines.en: Anything else in your pocket I can dissolve?
I make no sound when I eat.
I'm hungry again already.
You hit me and I spread out.
I splash away and gather back.
That flattened me.
A bit of me sticks to your boot.
I quiver and recover my shape.
I cling at your feet.

lines.zh: 我们碰在一起，我黏住了。
lines.en: We meet and I stick.

lines.zh: 我慢慢从你身上滑下来。
lines.en: I slowly slide off you.
A large patch is left on the ground.
I hop back to where I was.

lines.zh: 我贴在墙上，慢慢滑下去。
lines.en: I stick to the wall and slide down.

lines.zh: 这一下把我溅出一道边。
lines.en: That splashes a rim off me.

lines.zh: 我一弹一滚，滑出去老远。
lines.en: I bounce and roll a good way off.

lines.zh: 我重新聚成原来那么大。
lines.en: I gather back to my old size.
Two red blobs press together.
Her colour is paler than mine.
We merge into one.
A while later we part again.
She trembles in place a long while.
We hop apart.
Two wet patches mark the ground.
She's smaller than me.
We hop forward side by side.
At night neither of us moves.
I wrap it and let it dissolve.
It stays in there a long while.
I spit the stone out.
This won't dissolve.

lines.zh: 我用身子把它挤到旁边。
lines.en: I squeeze it aside with my body.
I swell once and take it in.
It rattles inside me.
I've grown a little.
I'll keep it until tomorrow.
I can eat anything at all.
You're only a few steps away.
I hop toward you.
I flatten a little to spring.
I can cover this one entirely.
My body has turned redder.
I hop faster than you walk.
I land and the ground jumps.
There's no way back behind you.
I hop to the other side at once.
I start bearing down on you.
I chase you hop by hop.
You run a step; I hop.
I land right at your feet.

lines.zh: 你踩在我身上，滑了一下。
lines.en: You step on me and slip.
I circle to your flank and leap.
I need no detour at all.
Not even stone stops me.
I squeeze through the gap.
You're running slower and slower.
Each hop is higher than the last.
I bear down and you're covered.

lines.zh: 我落地的冲击打在你身上。
lines.en: The shock of my landing hits you.
I wrap myself right around you.

lines.zh: 你打在我身上，手陷进去了。
lines.en: You strike me and your hand sinks in.
I bounce up and come down.
My surface burns you.

lines.zh: 你退出来，身上全是黏的。
lines.en: You pull out, covered in slime.

lines.zh: 我滚了一圈撞在你身上。
lines.en: I roll once into you.
I've stuck to your leg.
I press up on you little by little.
A red lump swells on the ground.
I spread flat, then rise.
I quiver and bounce.
There's a little dampness around.
I try one hop.
I splash on landing.
The ground here is flat — good for hopping.
Warmth in the air wakes me.
I ooze toward the warmth.

lines.zh: 我身上的红色慢慢深下去。
lines.en: The red on me deepens.
Fire bakes me and I steam.
I land and splatter wide.
The water dissolves me.

lines.zh: 气浪把我拍成一片薄红。
lines.en: The blast flattens me into a thin red sheet.

lines.zh: 一根东西穿过去，留了个洞。
lines.en: Something passes through and leaves a hole.
The light dries me out.
I'm smaller, and fainter.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，我散了一半。
lines.en: Lightning hits and half of me scatters.

lines.zh: 下面什么都没有，我一直落。
lines.en: Nothing below; I keep falling.
